read_only_external_references.allowed_use: Version and compatibility evidence only; do not execute or import the old runtime.
Historical device-profile evidence only; do not copy legacy OCR code or models.
Dataset provenance and isolation evidence only.

authorized_scope: Separate main, CPU OCR, and GPU OCR dependency locks and runtime directories
A versioned credential-free NDJSON worker protocol using only image hashes and data-root-relative paths
NVIDIA device discovery with stable hardware identity and per-start index mapping
Runtime and pipeline fingerprints that include locks, models, profile, code, and device evidence
CPU-first safety smoke, conservative GPU profile qualification, and explicit CPU fallback
Waybill-boundary fallback that discards uncommitted GPU attempt results
Per-image CPU/GPU critical-field and role difference reports
Windows-owned OCR process cleanup and heartbeat behavior
Application version 0.6.0 while real_platform_access remains false
forbidden_scope: Real Chengfeng access, login, capture, browser automation, credentials, cookies, signed URLs, or writes
Legacy project scripts, runtimes, models, databases, browser profiles, processes, ports, caches, or data mutation
Cloud OCR calls or paid-service activation
Platform expected weight, upload slot, or platform candidates in OCR requests or candidate selection
Installing CPU and GPU Paddle packages into the same environment or into the main application environment
Hard-coded developer paths, GPU index, GPU model, CUDA path, Edge path, or network settings
Silent model downloads during normal application or worker startup
Loop 7 template or role implementation before Loop 6 acceptance
Loop 8 audit production integration, Loop 9 real shadow access, or production switch
assumptions: The current Windows machine may qualify one local GPU profile, but source defaults remain portable and conservative.
The first GPU capacity remains one worker even when the device has more available memory.
A runtime failure is a technical failure or an explicit CPU fallback, never a finance review item.
The synthetic fixture proves protocol, isolation, and smoke behavior; it is not an OCR accuracy benchmark.
The main application remains free of Paddle and OpenCV imports.
